title: Maximal p-independent supersets
statement: Let $K/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], let $p$ be prime, and assume $k$ and $K$ have characteristic $p$. Put $F=kK^p$, the intermediate field generated by $k$ and all $p$-th powers in $K$. For a subset $T\subseteq K$, let $\mathcal M_p(T)$ consist of the finitely supported maps $E:T\to\mathbf N$ with $E(t)<p$ for all $t$, and write $t^E=\prod_{t\in T}t^{E(t)}$. If $S\subseteq K$ and the monomials $(s^E)_{E\in\mathcal M_p(S)}$ are $F$-linearly independent, then there exists $T\subseteq K$ containing $S$ whose bounded monomials are $F$-linearly independent and such that every $F$-p-independent subset $U$ with $T\subseteq U$ satisfies $U\subseteq T$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Definition Tag 07P1 (definition-p-basis) and Lemma Tag 07P2 (lemma-p-basis), third proof paragraph, maximal p-independent subsets; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07P2

proof.text: Extend each bounded exponent function on a subset by zero to K. Restriction and zero extension are inverse on functions supported in that subset; the bounds and monomial products are preserved. Thus its monomial independence is equivalent to LinearIndepOn of the common ambient monomial map on bounded exponent functions whose supports lie in the subset.

proof.text: For the collection of independent subsets containing S, a nonempty inclusion chain has upper bound its union. Every finite support in the union lies in one member, by DirectedOn.exists_mem_subset_of_finset_subset_biUnion. Hence the ambient supported-exponent sets form a directed union. Apply linearIndepOn_biUnion_of_directed to conclude independence. The empty chain has upper bound S.

proof.text: Apply zorn_subset to independent supersets of S. A larger independent subset still contains S, so the resulting maximal element is maximal among all independent subsets. Transfer ambient independence back along the exponent equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_maximal_pIndependent_superset
    {k : Type u} {K : Type v} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] [CharP K p]
    (S : Set K)
    (hS : LinearIndependent
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (fun a : K ↦ a ^ p)))
      (fun E : {E : S →₀ ℕ // ∀ s : S, E s < p} ↦
        E.val.prod (fun s e ↦ (s : K) ^ e))) :
    ∃ T : Set K, S ⊆ T ∧ Maximal (fun T : Set K ↦ LinearIndependent
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (fun a : K ↦ a ^ p)))
      (fun E : {E : T →₀ ℕ // ∀ t : T, E t < p} ↦
        E.val.prod (fun t e ↦ (t : K) ^ e))) T
